propositions: bridge_fsck reads prev_snapshot.json as offline Jira oracle and passes field values into ObservedJira.PRESENT for drift classification
narrowing prev_snapshot to a key-set (empty dict entries) silently degrades field-based drift classification without triggering test coverage of reconcile_once
bridge_fsck must distinguish between cases requiring actual field values (report indeterminate) and membership-only cases (classify normally) to prevent false drift reports
against key-set prev fixtures, bridge_fsck drift classification must be indeterminate for field-dependent cases and identical to full-payload for membership-only cases
against full-payload prev, bridge_fsck behavior must remain byte-identical with no regression
rebar bridge-fsck exit code and JSON shape must remain unchanged for both key-set and full-payload fixtures
